title: 2006 AMC 8 Problem 1
statement: Mindy made three purchases for \(\$1.98\), \(\$5.04\), and \(\$9.89\). What was her total, to the nearest dollar?

solutions.text:
Since all the values are already close to a whole number, we can just add the sums of the rounded numbers.

These prices round to \(\$ 2,\) \(\$ 5,\) and \(\$ 10,\) which add to \(\$ 17.\)

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: Round each price to the nearest dollar before adding.
The exact cents are not needed because the question asks for the nearest dollar.
